title: Writing a Wayland Compositor in Zig - Isaac Freund
summary: Isaac Freund, author of the River Wayland compositor, talks about writing a Wayland compositor in Zig. He covers why he chose Zig over C and Rust and how Zig can wrap a hairy C library.
why: HN recommends it as a phenomenal talk on Zig's C interop and on choosing between C, Rust and Zig for systems work.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: I loved his Zig+Wayland screencast [1], where he explained very engagingly how Zig is able to embrace and extend a pretty hairy C library
